title.narrative: Intergenerational Dialogue and Engagement of Youth and Women in Safeguarding Intangible Cultural Heritage in Tanzania.

description.narrative:
“Intergenerational Dialogue and Engagement of Youth and Women for Safeguarding Intangible Cultural Heritage in Tanzania” aims at strengthening awareness, participation, and knowledge transmission related to intangible cultural heritage among youth, women, and communities in Tanzania. The engagement responds to the growing need to safeguard living heritage practices, knowledge, expressions, and traditions that continue to play an important role in cultural identity, social cohesion, creativity, and community life.
Tanzania is rich in intangible cultural heritage expressed through oral traditions, performing arts, social practices, rituals, traditional craftsmanship and knowledge, food traditions, and other cultural expressions practiced by communities across the country. However, rapid social transformation, urbanization, changing lifestyles, and limited awareness among younger generations continue to pose challenges to the transmission and safeguarding of intangible cultural heritage. In many communities, opportunities for interaction and knowledge-sharing between elders, practitioners, women, and youth are becoming increasingly limited, creating risks for the continuity and visibility of living heritage practices.
The engagement will focus on promoting intergenerational dialogue and the active participation of youth and women as important approaches for safeguarding intangible cultural heritage. Through awareness-raising, dialogue sessions, storytelling activities, and learning engagements, the activities will create spaces for interaction between heritage practitioners, elders, cultural bearers, women, and young people to encourage the transmission of knowledge, skills, values, and cultural practices across generations. The engagement will also build on and complement ongoing UNESCO-supported activities related to intangible cultural heritage safeguarding, cultural awareness, youth and women participation, and community engagement.
The engagement seeks to strengthen understanding of the importance of safeguarding intangible cultural heritage as a living and dynamic source of identity, diversity, creativity, and sustainable development. It will further promote community participation and inclusive approaches that recognize the important role of communities, groups, practitioners, youth, and women in safeguarding living heritage.
